name: Blueberry
description: Blueberry (genus Vaccinium, section Cyanococcus). Commercial fresh-market production is dominated by northern highbush (Vaccinium corymbosum), southern highbush (interspecific V. corymbosum hybrids incorporating low-chill species such as V. darrowii), and rabbiteye (V. virgatum, syn. V. ashei). Created to give berry_ids a resolvable target: the platform references berry-blueberry throughout but shipped no berry entity record (see schema-assessment.md A-3, proposed-schema-enhancements.md P-1).
